## Data

To follow this workshop, you will need to download the following Imago's data product:

> [`Google Satellite Embedding V1 - London LSOAs (2020, 2024)`](https://data.imago.ac.uk/datasets/google-satellite-embedding-v1-london-lsoas-2020-2024)

For this, follow these steps:

1. [Log in](https://data.imago.ac.uk/auth/login?flow=cf1b2836-0dfe-4f55-90b0-f74713dda3be) at Imago's data catalogue. If you do not have an account, [sign up](https://data.imago.ac.uk/auth/registration) for free with an email address[^1].
2. Head to the data product's [page](https://data.imago.ac.uk/datasets/google-satellite-embedding-v1-london-lsoas-2020-2024).
3. You should now be able to see and download each year of embeddings at small
   area under the Resources section.

::: {.callout-tip}
Once you are ready to graduate from our demo dataset, you can dive right into
our newly released UK-wide data product of embeddings! You can access it at:

> [https://data.imago.ac.uk/datasets/google-satellite-embedding-v1-small-areas-2017-2024](https://data.imago.ac.uk/datasets/google-satellite-embedding-v1-small-areas-2017-2024)

This encompasses yearly embeddings from 2017 to 2024 at small area level (LSOA
equivalent for all UK nations).

:::


[^1]: The login is free and we only use it to keep track of usage, which [our
        funder](https://www.ukri.org/councils/esrc/) understandably wants to know about.
